text:
jenna-customer: Hey folks — enterprise customer (acme-inc) is getting 403s only for text generation calls. Embeddings and rerank endpoints succeed. Happening intermittently since key was provisioned yesterday via SSO. Can someone triage?

lina-cs: Sorry you're hitting this, jenna. Do you have a sample request/response and the request-id? That will speed triage.

jenna-customer: sample curl below, response body included. request-id: rwd-7891
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \  
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \  
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  
  -d '{"model":"rwd-pro-1", "input":"Summarize this"}'
```
Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"token missing: generation"}

mira-devex: :thinking: that error string matches a token-scope drop. Did the key originate from our SSO/SCIM provisioning flow or from the console 'create key' path?

jenna-customer: It was provisioned by an IdP service account via SCIM connector (Okta) — org admin pushed a CSV of scopes during provisioning.

mira-devex: Ok. We have a low-severity regression where scope CSVs with mixed delimiters (commas + spaces) can cause the last scope to be omitted when passed to the provisioner. That would explain why embed and rerank are present but generation is missing. Repro idea: create a service key with scopes string like "embed, rerank, generate" vs "embed,rerank,generate" and compare.

sam-platform: Can one of you paste the key metadata (scope list) from the org's key record (redwood console → keys → details) or a screenshot? We shouldn't ask them to share the secret. If we see the scopes array missing "generate" we can confirm.

jenna-customer: pasted metadata via DM to lina (scopes: ["embedding", "rerank"]) — generate is indeed missing.

lina-cs: Confirmed. Thanks. Next steps: 1) create a temporary scoped key for acme-inc with explicit generation permission and handoff; 2) file an infra bug to restore correct parsing in the SSO provisioner; 3) rotate the problematic key once new provisioning fix is deployed.

raj-sre: For the workaround, we can create a scoped service token via CLI safely. Command: 
```bash
redwood keys create --org acme-inc --description "temp-gen-fix" --scopes generate,embed,rerank
```
Note: this will create an audit event and must be approved by the customer's security contact. Also add IAM label "temp-rotation" so we can find and remove it later.

sam-platform: I'll take the infra bug. Assigning to platform-team with reproducible test. Will include a unit test for CSV parsing and an e2e for SCIM flow. Creating ticket now.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-5432 "SCIM scope CSV parsing drops final scope for mixed delimiters" assigned to platform-team.

mira-devex: For repro in our staging: I reproduced locally with two payloads. When SCIM payload had scopes: "embed, rerank, generate" the resulting record had only embed and rerank. With "embed,rerank,generate" all three show up. Adding this to INF-5432 notes.

lina-cs: Action list for CS: - Offer temporary token (raj will create via CLI) - Ask acme-inc to approve creation and rotation window - Notify when rotated and confirm generation calls succeed. For Platform: fix parsing and add defensive validation that errors if any requested scope is dropped.

jenna-customer: Thanks — acme-inc secops approved temporary token creation for 24h. Please proceed.

raj-sre: Creating temp key now and will DM the secret to jenna (not in channel). Will tag audit: temp-created-by-raj.

lina-cs: Great. Once acme-inc confirms generation calls pass, I'll keep the channel updated and close the loop. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
